description: Curated names of SCNU campus buildings in gis-buildings.json, keyed by footprintSource. Applied by fetch/scnuNames.mjs (also run from fetch/buildings.mjs). status: standing (modelled; nodeId is its selectable node unless an existing BLD_* node already covers the footprint), unresolved (modelled, no name found), demolished (not on current imagery; not modelled), removed (not in the official VR tour; dropped from gis-buildings.json and not modelled). Names marked estimated are labelled (추정).
sources: SCNU campus registry: POST https://w1.scnu.ac.kr/SCNU/campus/list.do (code, name, point), read 2026-10-24
SCNU 360 VR tour scene list: https://vr.scnu.ac.kr/360vr/tour.xml (scene_<code> titles), read 2026-10-24; panoramas used as visual reference only
OpenStreetMap building names (ODbL 1.0, © OpenStreetMap contributors), Overpass query of the bbox, 2026-10-24
VWorld 2D data API LT_C_BLDGINFO (bld_nm, dong_nm, grnd_flr) and LT_C_SPBD (buld_nm_dc), 2026-10-24, stored with SPACEN consent of 2026-10-24 (docs/data-licences.md D1)
VWorld z19 satellite imagery (local QA cache) for demolished/standing checks and the function of unnamed small structures
